page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "son" as "son", "establissement" as "establissement"). Printed hyphens kept at line ends ("tou-te", "Novem-bre", "bar-bouiller", "lumie-res", "pre-supposé", "l'obser-ve", "l'e-"). The italic/roman split inside the quotation (Leon IV, Benoist III) is approximated from the scan. The superscript-looking "1" after "l'obser-ve" is an inline mark with no matching note on this page.
